About The Role
 We're looking for experienced Data Engineers to join our growing team. You'll design, build, and maintain data pipelines that power analytics and AI across our client engagements.
 Responsibilities
Design and implement scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using Apache Spark and dbt
Build real-time streaming solutions with Apache Kafka
Architect data lakehouse solutions on Databricks or Snowflake
Collaborate with data scientists to operationalize ML models
Mentor junior engineers and contribute to engineering standards
 Requirements
5+ years of experience in data engineering
Strong proficiency in Python and SQL
Experience with Apache Spark, Kafka, and Airflow
Cloud platform expertise (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
Knowledge of data modeling and warehouse design patterns

Competitive salary and equity

Professional development budget
Health, dental, and vision insurance
401(k) with company match
